brand_notes: Kin One is Totem's $599 entry compact (4 in woofer, 6 Ω); measures with 6 ohm rating but 4.4 ohm minimum and 83 dB sensitivity vs 89 dB claimed (eac-totem-acoustic-kin-one, mfr-totem-acoustic-kin-one). Bison Monitor is the $2,300 step up with 8 Ω rating (mfr-totem-acoustic-bison-monitor).
takeaways: Erin Klippel: LW ±2.3 dB, f3 87 Hz, pref 3.7 / 6.6 with sub
Measured sensitivity 83.1 dB vs 89 dB claimed (about 6 dB gap)
Min impedance 4.4 Ω above 80 Hz on a 6 Ω rating: below-iec; EPDR 2.6 Ω
THD about 3.5% at 96 dB near 2-3 kHz (graph-read); compression over 3 dB around 200 Hz at 102 dB
SoundStage! Access: slightly bright, needs a sub, strains loud in big room
log_bullets: Conflict: claimed 89 dB vs measured 83.1 dB; impedance below-iec
